MRUCount.text: How many recently used files there are.

MRUFile.text: One of the recently used files.
MRUFile.returns: its full name, or empty if there is none at that place

params.Index: position in the list, 0 for the newest

TfrmMain.NoteFileUsed.text: Records that a file was opened or saved: it goes to the top of the recently used files, the list is saved to the registry, and the File menu entries are rebuilt.

TfrmMain.DoOpenRecent.text: Click handler of the recently used files in the File menu: opens the file the item stands for (its number is in the item's Tag).

TfrmMain.OpenRecentFile.text: Opens the n-th recently used file as a document, as choosing it in the File menu does. A file that is no longer there is not opened: it is taken off the list (and the registry), and a message says so. Any other error opening it is reported and the list is left alone.

params.Index: position in the list, 0 for the newest

TfrmMain.RecentMenuText.text: The File menu entries made from the recently used files, as text (caption, then the full file name, for each), for tests.
TfrmMain.RecentMenuText.returns: the entries, each followed by a semicolon; the separator shows as "-"

settingstest.pas::Show.text: Prints the recently used files the settings hold.
